054        public static Map<String, String> stringTokens = new HashMap<String, String>();
055        
056        /**
057         * Goal here is to return tokens for which an == comparison works.
058         * @param str
059         * @return
060         */
061        public static Object getToken(String str) {
062                if (!stringTokens.containsKey(str)) {
063                        stringTokens.put(str, str);
064                }
065                return stringTokens.get(str);
066        }
067        
068        public static String SYSTEM_MUSIC_PREFIX = "core_sys_music_";
069        
070        public Object getStateTokenForCampaignLocation() {
071                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
072                if (playerFleet.getContainingLocation() instanceof StarSystemAPI) {
073                        /*
074                         Just returning CAMPAIGN_SYSTEM and letting getMusicSetIdForCampaignStateToken()
075                         return the musicSetId misses the case where there's a transition between
076                         two star systems with different music, without hyperspace travel in between -
077                         since there would be no state transition (due to it being the same CAMPAIGN_SYSTEM state), 
078                         a restart of the music - and a change to a different music set - would not be triggered.
079                         
080                         Since the state ID includes the music set id, this means that moving between
081                         two systems with the same $musicSetId will not trigger a state change and
082                         the same music will just keep playing uninterrupted.
083                         */
084                        StarSystemAPI system = (StarSystemAPI) playerFleet.getContainingLocation();
085                        String musicSetId = system.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY_MISSION);
086                        if (musicSetId != null) {
087                                return getToken(SYSTEM_MUSIC_PREFIX + musicSetId);
088                        }
089                        musicSetId = system.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY);
090                        if (musicSetId != null) {
091                                return getToken(SYSTEM_MUSIC_PREFIX + musicSetId);
092                        }
093                        return CAMPAIGN_SYSTEM;
094                }
095//              float depth = Misc.getAbyssalDepthOfPlayer();
096//              if (depth > 0.5f) {
097//                      return NO_MUSIC;
098//              }
099                return CAMPAIGN_HYPERSPACE;
100        }
101        
102        public String getMusicSetIdForCombat(CombatEngineAPI engine) {
103                if (engine.getContext() != null && engine.getContext().getOtherFleet() != null) {
104                        CampaignFleetAPI other = engine.getContext().getOtherFleet();
105                        MemoryAPI mem = other.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
106                        if (mem.contains(COMBAT_MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY)) {
107                                return mem.getString(COMBAT_MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY);
108                        }
109                        String factionSet = other.getFaction().getMusicMap().get(COMBAT_MUSIC_SET_FACTION_KEY);
110                        if (factionSet != null) return factionSet;
111                }
112                return "music_combat";
113        }

120        public float getMusicSetVolumeForCampaignStateToken(Object token, Object param) {
121                if (token == CAMPAIGN_HYPERSPACE) {
122                        //float depth = Misc.getAbyssalDepthOfPlayer();
123                        // need to check this way so that the hyperspace track doesn't fade back in
124                        // right after transitiong to an abyssal system (as the track fades out)
125                        CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
126                        float depth = 0f;
127                        if (pf != null) depth = Misc.getAbyssalDepth(pf.getLocationInHyperspace());
128                        float vol = 1f - depth;
129                        if (vol > 1f) vol = 1f;
130                        if (vol < 0f) vol = 0f;
131                        return vol;
132                }
133                return 1f;
134        }
135        
136        public String getMusicSetIdForCampaignStateToken(Object token, Object param) {
137                if (token == MARKET) {
138                        return getMarketMusicSetId(param);
139                }
140                if (token == ENCOUNTER) {
141                        return getEncounterMusicSetId(param);
142                }
143                if (token == CAMPAIGN_SYSTEM || 
144                                (token instanceof String && ((String)token).startsWith(SYSTEM_MUSIC_PREFIX))) {
145                        return getStarSystemMusicSetId();
146                }
147                if (token == CAMPAIGN_HYPERSPACE) {
148                        return getHyperspaceMusicSetId();
149                }
150                if (token == PLANET_SURVEY) {
151                        return getPlanetSurveyMusicSetId(param);
152                }
153                if (token == NO_MUSIC) {
154                        return null;
155                }
156                return null;
157        }
158        
159        /**
160         * @param param is a MarketAPI.
161         * @return
162         */
163        protected String getPlanetSurveyMusicSetId(Object param) {
164                SectorEntityToken token = null;
165                if (param instanceof SectorEntityToken) {
166                        token = (SectorEntityToken) param;
167                } else if (param instanceof MarketAPI) {
168                        token = ((MarketAPI)param).getPlanetEntity();
169                }
170                if (token != null) {    
171                        String musicSetId = token.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY_MISSION);
172                        if (musicSetId != null) return musicSetId;
173                        musicSetId = token.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY);
174                        if (musicSetId != null) return musicSetId;
175                }
176                return "music_survey_and_scavenge";
177        }

182        
183        protected String getStarSystemMusicSetId() {
184                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
185                if (playerFleet.getContainingLocation() instanceof StarSystemAPI) {
186                        StarSystemAPI system = (StarSystemAPI) playerFleet.getContainingLocation();
187                        String musicSetId = system.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY_MISSION);
188                        if (musicSetId != null) return musicSetId;
189                        musicSetId = system.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY);
190                        if (musicSetId != null) return musicSetId;
191
192                        if (system.hasTag(Tags.SYSTEM_ABYSSAL)) {
193                                return "music_campaign_abyssal";
194                        }
195                        if (system.hasTag(Tags.THEME_CORE) ||
196                                        !Misc.getMarketsInLocation(system, Factions.PLAYER).isEmpty()) {
197                                return "music_campaign";
198                        }
199                }
200                
201                return "music_campaign_non_core";
202        }
203        
204        protected String getEncounterMusicSetId(Object param) {
205                if (param instanceof SectorEntityToken) {
206                        SectorEntityToken token = (SectorEntityToken) param;
207                        
208                        String musicSetId = token.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY_MISSION);
209                        if (musicSetId != null) return musicSetId;
210                        musicSetId = token.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY);
211                        if (musicSetId != null) return musicSetId;
212                        
213                        if (Entities.ABYSSAL_LIGHT.equals(token.getCustomEntityType())) {
214                                return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_NEUTRAL;
215                        }
216                        if (Entities.CORONAL_TAP.equals(token.getCustomEntityType())) {
217                                return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_MYSTERIOUS_AGGRO;
218                        }
219                        if (Entities.WRECK.equals(token.getCustomEntityType())) {
220                                return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_NEUTRAL;
221                        }
222                        if (Entities.DERELICT_GATEHAULER.equals(token.getCustomEntityType())) {
223                                return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_MYSTERIOUS_NON_AGGRESSIVE;
224                        }
225                        if (Entities.DERELICT_CRYOSLEEPER.equals(token.getCustomEntityType())) {
226                                return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_REVELATION;
227                        }
228                        if (Entities.ASTEROID_BASE.equals(token.getCustomEntityType())) {
229                                return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_NEUTRAL;
230                        }
231                        
232                        if (Entities.DEBRIS_FIELD_SHARED.equals(token.getCustomEntityType())) {
233                                return "music_survey_and_scavenge";
234                        }
235                        if (token.hasTag(Tags.GATE)) {
236                                return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_NEUTRAL;
237                        }
238                        if (token.hasTag(Tags.OBJECTIVE)) {
239                                return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_NEUTRAL;
240                        }
241                        if (token.hasTag(Tags.SALVAGEABLE)) {
242                                if (token.getMemoryWithoutUpdate() != null && token.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$hasDefenders")) {
243                                        if (token.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$limboMiningStation")) {
244                                                return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_MYSTERIOUS_AGGRO;
245                                        }
246                                        if (token.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$limboWormholeCache")) {
247                                                return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_MYSTERIOUS_AGGRO;
248                                        }
249                                        return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_NEUTRAL;
250                                }
251                                return "music_survey_and_scavenge";
252                        }
253                        if (token.hasTag(Tags.SALVAGE_MUSIC)) {
254                                return "music_survey_and_scavenge";
255                        }
256                        
257//                      MemoryAPI memory = token.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
258//                      if (!memory.getBoolean("$defenderFleetDefeated") && memory.getBoolean("$hasDefenders")) { 
259//                              CampaignFleetAPI defenders = memory.getFleet("$defenderFleet");
260//                              if (defenders != null) token = defenders;
261//                      }
262                        
263                        if (token.getFaction() != null) {
264                                FactionAPI faction = (FactionAPI) token.getFaction();
265                                String type = null;
266                                //MemoryAPI mem = token.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
267                                boolean hostile = false;
268                                boolean knowsWhoPlayerIs = false;
269                                if (token instanceof CampaignFleetAPI) {
270                                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet = (CampaignFleetAPI) token;
271                                        if (fleet.getAI() instanceof ModularFleetAIAPI) {
272                                                hostile = ((ModularFleetAIAPI) fleet.getAI()).isHostileTo(Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet());
273                                        }
274                                        knowsWhoPlayerIs = fleet.knowsWhoPlayerIs();
275                                }
276                                
277                                if (faction.isAtWorst(Factions.PLAYER, RepLevel.FAVORABLE) && knowsWhoPlayerIs && !hostile) {
278                                        type = "encounter_friendly";
279                                } else if ((faction.isAtBest(Factions.PLAYER, RepLevel.SUSPICIOUS) && knowsWhoPlayerIs) || hostile) {
280                                        type = "encounter_hostile";
281                                } else {
282                                        type = "encounter_neutral";
283                                }
284                                
285                                if (type != null) {
286                                        musicSetId = faction.getMusicMap().get(type);
287                                        if (musicSetId != null) {
288                                                return musicSetId;
289                                        }
290                                }
291                                
292                                musicSetId = null;
293                                if (faction.isAtWorst(Factions.PLAYER, RepLevel.FAVORABLE)) {
294                                        musicSetId = "music_default_encounter_friendly";
295                                } else if (faction.isAtBest(Factions.PLAYER, RepLevel.SUSPICIOUS)) {
296                                        musicSetId = "music_default_encounter_hostile";
297                                } else {
298                                        musicSetId = "music_default_encounter_neutral";
299                                }
300                                return musicSetId;
301                        }
302                }
303                return null;
304        }
305        
306
307        protected String getMarketMusicSetId(Object param) {
308                if (param instanceof MarketAPI) {
309                        MarketAPI market = (MarketAPI) param;
310                        
311                        String musicSetId = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY_MISSION);
312                        if (musicSetId != null) return musicSetId;
313                        musicSetId = market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY);
314                        if (musicSetId != null) return musicSetId;
315                        
316                        if (market.getPrimaryEntity() != null &&
317                                        market.getPrimaryEntity().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$abandonedStation")) {
318                                return getPlanetSurveyMusicSetId(param);
319                        }
320                        
321                        if (market.getPrimaryEntity() != null &&
322                                        market.getPrimaryEntity().getId().equals("station_galatia_academy")) {
323                                if (TutorialMissionIntel.isTutorialInProgress()) {
324                                        return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_MYSTERIOUS_AGGRO;
325                                }
326                                return MUSIC_GALATIA_ACADEMY;
327                        }
328                        
329                        //if (  market.getPrimaryEntity() != null &&
330                        //              market.getPrimaryEntity().getId().equals("58966elysium")) {
331                        //      return MUSIC_ENCOUNTER_NEUTRAL;
332                        //}
333                        
334                        FactionAPI faction = market.getFaction();
335                        if (faction != null) {
336                                String type = null;
337                                if (faction.isAtWorst(Factions.PLAYER, RepLevel.FAVORABLE)) {
338                                        type = "market_friendly";
339                                } else if (faction.isAtBest(Factions.PLAYER, RepLevel.SUSPICIOUS)) {
340                                        type = "market_hostile";
341                                } else {
342                                        type = "market_neutral";
343                                }
344                                
345                                if (type != null) {
346                                        musicSetId = faction.getMusicMap().get(type);
347                                        if (musicSetId != null) {
348                                                return musicSetId;
349                                        }
350                                }
351                                
352                                musicSetId = null;
353                                if (faction.isAtWorst(Factions.PLAYER, RepLevel.FAVORABLE)) {
354                                        musicSetId = "music_default_market_friendly";
355                                } else if (faction.isAtBest(Factions.PLAYER, RepLevel.SUSPICIOUS)) {
356                                        musicSetId = "music_default_market_hostile";
357                                } else {
358                                        musicSetId = "music_default_market_neutral";
359                                }
360                                return musicSetId;
361                        }
362                }
363                return null;
364        }
365}
